newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau police hold 100 for questioning after sweeps.
newsitem.headline: Macau police hold 100 for questioning after sweeps.

text.p: Macau police said on Sunday they had detained more than 100 people for questioning after a sweep of several casinos in the Portuguese-administered territory.
The crackdown was sparked by a spate of gangland style killings and bombings in Macao in recent weeks.
None of those detained had been formally arrested, a police spokesman said.
Organised gangs, known as triad societies, have been blamed by the police for waging a "turf war" over gambling-related businesses in Macau, which is famed for its casinos.
